views.name: qualifying_q1_times_ms
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  q.qualifyId,
  q.raceId,
  q.driverId,
  q.q1,
  (
    -- convert q.q1 which is like '1:26.572' or '76.572' or NULL into milliseconds
    CASE
      WHEN instr(q.q1, ':') > 0 THEN
        (
          -- split minutes:seconds.milliseconds
          (cast(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60.0
           + cast(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
          ) * 1000.0
        )
      WHEN trim(q.q1) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN q.q1 IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE
        -- assume seconds with fractional part
        cast(q.q1 AS REAL) * 1000.0
    END
  ) AS q1_ms
FROM qualifying_rows q
WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
views.description: Parsed q1 lap times for qualifying rows converted into milliseconds to allow numeric sorting and comparisons.

views.name: results_with_parsed_fastest_lap_speed
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  TRIM(r.fastestLapSpeed) AS fastestLapSpeed_raw,
  CASE
    WHEN r.fastestLapSpeed IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- Try to extract a numeric value possibly containing commas and non-digit suffixes.
      -- Remove commas, trim, attempt cast; if it fails, NULL.
      (CASE
         WHEN TRIM(REPLACE(r.fastestLapSpeed, ',', '')) = '' THEN NULL
         ELSE CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(r.fastestLapSpeed, ',', '')) AS REAL)
       END)
  END AS fastestLapSpeed_num
FROM results r
views.description: Normalized results rows with fastestLapSpeed parsed to a numeric value (milliseconds or numeric km/h as float) and trimmed; preserves one row per results.resultId.

    ELSE CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)
  END AS fastestLapSpeed_num

LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId

views.name: results_fastestlap_numeric
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  r.fastestLapSpeed AS fastestLapSpeed,
  CASE
    WHEN r.fastestLapSpeed IS NULL THEN NULL
    -- strip non-numeric characters except dot and comma and possible per-space units, handle comma as decimal separator if present and no dot
    WHEN (trim(r.fastestLapSpeed) = '') THEN NULL
    ELSE (
      -- attempt to extract a numeric-like token from the text
      -- first, remove common unit strings (e.g., "km/h", "kph") and parentheses, then trim
      -- SQLite lacks full regex capture; use replace to remove common unit variations and commas
      -- normalize comma decimal to dot only when there is no dot present
      CASE
        WHEN instr(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), ' ', ''), 'km/h') > 0 THEN
          -- remove letters and slashes, keep digits, dot and comma
          NULLIF(
            -- if contains comma and not dot, convert comma to dot
            CASE
              WHEN instr(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), ' ', ''), '.') = 0 AND instr(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), ' ', ''), ',') > 0
              THEN replace(
                     replace(replace(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), 'km/h', ''), 'kph', ''), 'kmh', ''),
                     ',', '.'
                   )
              ELSE replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), 'km/h', ''), 'kph', ''), 'kmh', ''), ',', '')
            END
          , '') 
        ELSE
          NULLIF(
            CASE
              WHEN instr(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), ' ', ''), '.') = 0 AND instr(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), ' ', ''), ',') > 0
              THEN replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), 'km/h', ''), 'kph', ''), 'kmh', ''), ',', '.')
              ELSE replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(r.fastestLapSpeed), 'km/h', ''), 'kph', ''), 'kmh', ''), ',', '')
            END
          , '')
      END
    )
  END AS fastestLapSpeed_num
FROM results r
views.description: Normalized one row per results.resultId with extracted numeric fastestLapSpeed (as a REAL). Converts text-form values (e.g., with units) into a numeric value when possible; rows where numeric extraction fails will have fastestLapSpeed_num = NULL.

views.description: Aggregated measures per driver: total/maximum wins and maximum points observed across driverStandings records. One row per driver (driverId) with raw aggregates needed for ranking and comparison.

views.name: drivers_name_index
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.driverId,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  d.driverRef,
  d.code,
  d.nationality
FROM drivers AS d
views.description: Simple projection for driver display name and key fields to support lookups and presentation.

views.name: drivers_with_age_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.driverId,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  d.dob,
  CAST((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', d.dob)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', d.dob)) AS INTEGER) AS age_years
FROM drivers d
WHERE d.dob IS NOT NULL
views.description: Driver-level relation that precomputes current age in years (rounded down) from dob for quick filtering and sorting. Still one row per driver.

views.name: race_with_circuit_53
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.name AS "races.name AS race_name",
  races.date AS "races.date AS race_date",
  races.year AS "races.year",
  races.circuitId AS "races.circuitId",
  circuits.name AS "circuits.name AS circuit_name",
  circuits.location AS "circuits.location AS circuit_location"
FROM races
JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
views.description: Denormalized view: one row per race joined to its circuit, exposing race details plus circuit name and location for display and filtering.

views.name: races_core_54
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.year AS year,
  races.round AS round,
  races.circuitId AS circuitId,
  races.name AS name,
  races.date AS date,
  races.time AS time
FROM races
views.description: Canonical race identity and basic attributes, one row per race.

views.name: results_by_driver_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  results.resultId AS resultId,
  results.raceId AS raceId,
  results.driverId AS driverId,
  results.constructorId AS constructorId,
  results.number AS number,
  results.grid AS grid,
  results.position AS position,
  results.positionText AS positionText,
  results.positionOrder AS positionOrder,
  results.points AS points,
  results.laps AS laps,
  results.time AS time,
  results.milliseconds AS milliseconds,
  results.fastestLap AS fastestLap,
  results.rank AS rank,
  results.fastestLapTime AS fastestLapTime,
  results.fastestLapSpeed AS fastestLapSpeed,
  results.statusId AS statusId
FROM results
WHERE results.position IS NOT NULL
views.description: Race results at the driver-race level: one row per (raceId, driverId, resultId) with position and points. Useful for filtering a driver's finishing position, points, laps, and status per race.

views.name: results_with_race_and_driver
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  results.resultId AS resultId,
  results.raceId AS raceId,
  results.driverId AS driverId,
  results.constructorId AS constructorId,
  results.points AS points,
  results.position AS position,
  results.positionText AS positionText,
  results.milliseconds AS milliseconds,
  results.fastestLap AS fastestLap,
  races.name AS race_name,
  races.year AS race_year
FROM results
JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId
WHERE results.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per race result (one result record) joined to its race and driver identifiers and raw time measures. Keeps results with non-null milliseconds to support min/time comparisons.

views.name: race_results
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  r.constructorId,
  r.grid,
  r.position,
  r.positionText,
  r.positionOrder,
  r.points,
  r.laps,
  r.time,
  r.milliseconds,
  r.statusId,
  r.fastestLap,
  r.fastestLapTime,
  r.fastestLapSpeed,
  races.name AS race_name,
  races.date AS race_date,
  races.year AS race_year,
  races.round AS race_round,
  races.circuitId
FROM results r
JOIN races ON races.raceId = r.raceId
views.description: One row per race result (a driver in a race) combining results with race metadata to support queries about when a driver competed and what they scored.

views.name: races_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.name AS name,
  races.year AS year,
  races.circuitId AS circuitId,
  races.date AS date,
  races.time AS time,
  circuits.country AS country
FROM races
LEFT JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
views.description: One row per race with basic identifying and location attributes useful for cohort filters (e.g. name, country, year, circuit).

views.name: races_with_circuit_location
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.name AS "races.name",
  races.year AS "races.year",
  races.date AS "races.date",
  races.time AS "races.time",
  races.circuitId AS "races.circuitId",
  circuits.name AS "circuits.name AS circuit_name",
  circuits.location AS "circuits.location",
  circuits.country AS "circuits.country AS circuit_country",
  circuits.lat AS "circuits.lat",
  circuits.lng AS "circuits.lng"
FROM races
LEFT JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
views.description: Denormalized race rows joined to their circuit to expose the circuit country/location alongside race attributes. Useful when the country might be stored on the circuit rather than race.

views.name: race_name_country_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  LOWER(TRIM(races.name)) AS normalized_name,
  LOWER(TRIM(circuits.country)) AS normalized_country
FROM races
LEFT JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
views.description: Canonical projection of race name and country fields (trimmed/canonicalized) to enable consistent text comparisons and avoid mismatches due to casing/whitespace.
